name: audit-fixture-realworld-app
_comment: Phase 2 hoisted compat audit. Dogfood/large-graph fixture. Mirrors the bench/fixture-large dep list (21 direct deps from the 'webpack-adjacent mix') so the audit covers a realistically-sized real-world dep graph — ~266 transitive packages. Bench harness times this graph; this fixture verifies CORRECTNESS on it (every direct dep loads, smoke exercises a handful of common code paths). The bench and the audit reading the same dep set is intentional: any regression that fails the audit but slips the bench is a correctness gap.
